referent.positive_definition: The thing, situation, event, composition, or unresolved target being referred to; it is not constituted by its current system description.
referent.discriminator: If a description, map, role, or classification can change while the tracked subject remains the same subject, that changing representation is not the Referent.

map_projection.positive_definition: A representation of a Referent produced under particular mapping conditions. It is not the Referent itself.
map_projection.discriminator: Could the representation change while the Referent remains unchanged? Could two validly produced representations differ while referring to the same territory? If yes, they are maps, not territory.

reference_frame.positive_definition: The indexing relation relative to which a Referent is represented.
reference_frame.discriminator: If mapper and evidence source remain fixed but the index relative to which the Referent is considered changes, the reference frame changed.

mapper.positive_definition: The actor or process producing the map/projection.
mapper.discriminator: Change who or what constructs the representation while holding Referent and reference frame constant.

access.positive_definition: The evidentiary or observational path available to the mapper.
access.discriminator: Same mapper, same Referent, same reference frame, different sensory/tool/testimony/inference path.

quadrant.positive_definition: One of the four structurally available indexing relations through which the same focal Referent can be interrogated.
quadrant.discriminator: Changing quadrant does not change the Referent.

ul.positive_definition: The focal Referent under a self-indexed reference frame.
ul.discriminator: The reference-frame anchor/index is the focal Referent itself; the mapper and access path remain separately represented.

holoarchic_level.positive_definition: Relative structural level determined through asymmetric existence dependency.
holoarchic_level.discriminator: Test whether the higher-order whole depends on constituents/configuration for its continued existence while those constituents can remain themselves after the higher-order whole disappears.

master_key.positive_definition: The active work orientation that specifies scope, definition of done, and relevance for the current work relative to the focal Referent.
master_key.discriminator: Hold Referent and reference conditions stable while changing scope/done/relevance; if relevant distinctions, completion, or resolution change, the Master Key changed rather than the territory.

directional_tendency.positive_definition: A structurally available direction of change through which a holon may be interrogated; Drive and Capacity are two readings of the same tendency rather than independent axes.
directional_tendency.discriminator: If Drive and Capacity can be varied as labels without changing the underlying direction being examined, they are readings of one directional tendency rather than separate structural dimensions.

transcendence.positive_definition: The directional tendency toward vertical emergence: formation or participation in a higher-order organization or capability that is not merely better persistence or adaptation of the focal organization at its current holoarchic level.
transcendence.discriminator: Ask whether a higher-order organization/capability appears under the holoarchic existence-dependency test. If only same-level persistence/performance improves, transcendence is not thereby established.

dissolution.positive_definition: The directional tendency toward loss of the organization by which the focal holon continues to exist as that holon; some or all constituents may remain themselves.
dissolution.discriminator: If the constitutive organization disappears and the focal whole no longer exists as itself while constituents may remain, dissolution signal is high at that focal level.

line.positive_definition: An independently tracked dimension required when collapsing it into another dimension would hide a materially distinct pattern of development, performance, competence, degradation, or change.
line.discriminator: A candidate Line must have a discrimination function: varying this dimension can change the relevant assessment while another purportedly similar dimension remains fixed. An arbitrary variable is not a Line merely because it can be measured.

stage.positive_definition: A position in an explicitly identified ordered trajectory, with criteria for movement along that trajectory.
stage.discriminator: A Stage claim requires an identified trajectory plus criteria distinguishing positions/movement; a transient condition or higher structural Level is insufficient.

state.positive_definition: A presently instantiated condition whose observation basis and temporal/duration limits are separately recoverable.
state.discriminator: A condition can change and later reverse while the Referent and its Stage remain stable; if so, State is the appropriate dimension unless separate evidence establishes more.

type.positive_definition: A categorical distinction whose alternatives produce a stated difference relevant to the current inquiry.
type.discriminator: The Type distinction is justified only when alternatives have a stated discriminating consequence under the current Master Key; resemblance alone is insufficient.

question_forward.positive_definition: A structural mechanism that converts unresolved or low/no-signal material into an answerable future discrimination with explicit detection and re-entry conditions.
question_forward.discriminator: A low/no-signal return is incomplete unless it specifies the calibrated question, what answer/evidence would change the assessment, how a high-signal case could present, and what triggers/consequence re-entry would have.
